body.name: Total full-label nonlinear Airy rule
body.construction: On observations produced by \(\mathrm{def:independent\text{-}qstar\text{-}design}\), set \[\delta_n^\star=\operatorname{proj}_{[-1,1]}\left\{n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^nT_i-n^{-2/3}h_{\kappa}\left(n^{-2/3}\sum_{i=1}^nU_i\right)\right\}.\] Define the rule to equal zero on every label-outcome string outside the support of that design.
